mission_en: To make getting around and sending things in Garowe safe, fair and instant, while giving Bajaaj drivers steady, dignified income.
mission_so: Inaan safarka iyo u dirista alaabta Garoowe ka dhigno mid ammaan ah, caddaalad ah oo degdeg ah, iyadoo darawallada Bajaajta la siinayo dakhli joogto ah oo sharaf leh.
vision_en: To become the most trusted mobility network in Puntland and across Somali cities.
vision_so: Inaan noqonno shabakadda gaadiidka ee ugu kalsoonida badan Puntland iyo magaalooyinka Soomaaliyeed.
personality: Shows up when promised. Fares shown before the trip, no surprises.
Fast to book, fast to arrive, fast to read.
Greets people like a neighbour. Respectful to riders and drivers alike.
Local streets, local drivers, local language first.
Clean, confident technology that anyone can use.
voice: Short sentences. One idea per line. Prices and times up front.
Warm greetings, no heavy slang, never sarcastic.
Somali first for local audiences, English alongside.
Drivers are partners, never 'workers'. Riders are guests.
description_en: BajGo is Garowe's on-demand Bajaaj app for rides and deliveries. Book a Bajaaj or send a parcel in a few taps, see your fare before you go, and track your driver live.
description_so: BajGo waa app-ka Bajaajta ee Garoowe ee safarka iyo dirista alaabta. Ku dalbo Bajaaj ama dir xirmo dhowr taabasho, arag lacagta ka hor intaadan bixin, oo si toos ah ula soco darawalkaaga.
bio_en: Bajaaj rides and deliveries in Garowe. Fair fares, live tracking, local drivers. baj-go.com
bio_so: Safar iyo dirid Bajaaj ah oo Garoowe ah. Qiimo cad, la socod toos ah, darawallo deegaanka ah. baj-go.com

launch.en: BajGo is here. Garowe, one tap away.
launch.so: BajGo waa yimid. Garoowe, hal taabasho.

ride.en: Need a Bajaaj? Tap. It's on the way.
ride.so: Bajaaj ma u baahan tahay? Taabo, waa kuu soo socotaa.

delivery.en: Send it across Garowe in minutes.
delivery.so: U dir Garoowe oo dhan daqiiqado gudahood.

driver.en: Drive with BajGo. More trips. Fair pay. Your Bajaaj.
driver.so: La shaqee BajGo. Safarro badan, dakhli caddaalad ah, Bajaajkaaga.

discount.so: Saddexda safar ee ugu horreeya: [X]% dhimis, koodh [CODE].

download.en: Get the app. Book your first ride today.
download.so: Soo deji app-ka. Dalbo safarkaaga ugu horreeya maanta.
